newsitem.title: USA: FBL Financial Group Inc Q1 oper net rises.
newsitem.headline: FBL Financial Group Inc Q1 oper net rises.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: 1997 Q1 operating net reduced by $13,971,000 from adjustments for realized gains, value of insurance in force acquired, unearned revenue reserve and income taxes and a loss from FBL Ventures of $326,000.

1996 operating net increased by $1,000,000 from adjustments for realized gains, value of insurance in force acquired, unearned revenue reserve and income taxes; loss of $1,085,000 from FBL Ventures; and proforma adjustments of $1,316,000 from preferred dividends and foregone investment income on dividends to preferred stockholders.
